Name: Pam's Less Ugly House
Author: 0Renciel
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][u][b][i]Pam's Less Ugly House[/i][/b]

[/u][/size][size=3]A very simple mod with an unusually long description.[/size]

[size=3]So, you walk into the good ol' trailer to woo lovable Penny, until you see Pam slouching on that awful green couch of hers covered in radioactive green goo and decided you know what? I wouldn't want my mother in law be that miserable. So you spontaneously decide to give her a rickety old bedroom that looks to be one mighty Pam-Stomp away from collapsing![/size]

[size=4][i][b]Why doesn't she have a door?
[/b]
[/i][/size][size=3]You may ask, well because she's Pam.
She tunnels through trees like butter and she'll be damned if a 3 inch thick wooden doorframe could stop her.

In all seriousness, I decided against on adding a door as in my head canon Pam gave the best room to her daughter as it was the very least she could do for her. That meant sacrificing her privacy for Penny.
Even Penny's floor is fleshed out unlike her own where it's still the bareboned dilapidating rotted wood.
[/size][size=1]Pam may not be the best person or mother, but in terms of living quarters she still gave the one and only room with a bed to her daughter. That is enough for me.
[/size]

[b][size=5]HEY YOU![/size]

[/b][size=3]Now that I have your attention.. I don't know how well this works with the new 1.5 feature..

[/size][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]SPOILERS[/size]
[/color]
[/b][size=3][spoiler]..Where you upgrade Pam's trailer into an actual livable house.
I know right? What are we, a charity?
Haven't gotten the opportunity to test that out yet, but dear Yoba that is the biggest anxiety if I've ever had one.

In theory nothing [i]should [/i]go crazy once you've upgraded her Trailer, it'll just get replaced by the house like normal, but in a case that something does go horribly wrong then feel free to send a bug report and I'll wrack up my brain to try and come with a solution. Thanks![/spoiler][/size]

[size=3]This has the most simplest coding that is known to man, so though I dread it I know there will be bugs and whatnot that I have overlooked. If you've spotted one, feel free to send a bug report [/size][u]AFTER[/u][size=3] reading below. Bug reports from those who has clearly not read the mod description will be ignored and/or deleted![/size]
[size=1](Note: Recolors will likely not work for the couch and Pam's bed as these are custom tilesheets.)[/size]

[size=4][i]Enjoy![/i][/size]


[size=5][u][b][i][color=#ff0000]Very Important, Read me![/color][/i][/b]

[/u]What this mod [u][b][i][color=#ff0000]DOESN'T[/color][/i][/b][/u] do:[/size]

[size=4][b][s]1. Add a night time version[/s][/b][/size]

[size=3]Learned how to do that, no more eternal sunlight :(([/size]

[size=4][b]2. Edits the Heart events[/b]

[/size][size=3]I made this mod with the VANILLA heart events in mind. So in theory, it should work fine [u]without[/u] any mods that expands on Pam's or Penny's story, specifically ones that adds heart events/cutscenes inside the trailer.

[u][b]Now, in relation to that I am not sure how well this mod works with a big expansion.[/b][/u]

[/size][size=4][b]3. Give Pam a better personality[/b][/size]

[size=3]Sorry, nothing I can do about that.


[/size][size=5][u][b][i]Compatibilities[/i][/b][/u][/size]


[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]East Scarp[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], does that add a cutscene in the trailer? Probably not, it should be fine.[/size]
[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]RidgeSide Village[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=4]does that also add a cutscene in the trailer? If not, then it should also be fine.[/size]
[u][color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=4]uhhhhh..

[/size][size=3]I don't play SVE, likely will not do so in the foreseeable future, So I don't know if that edits the Trailers interior or not. If it [i]does, [/i]then it is likely [u][color=#ff0000]not[/color][/u] compatible alongside it. Sorry![/size]
